explication: GitHub Desktop is an Electron desktop client for working with local Git repositories and GitHub. The user-facing workflow centers on adding or cloning a repository, viewing its changes and history, and committing work; GitHub account and pull-request features extend that workflow. The main process and React UI form the desktop shell, while application state, dispatch, Git operations, and API access provide internal layers. Edges are limited to relationships shown in the README or source references/excerpts; several feature subsystems are represented from the tree without asserting unverified call paths.
